'''Bowenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Commanding Imperial defenses around the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]], he executed a spy, [[Danak]], that was delivered to him by a local Imperial sympathizer named [[Ivo (Balmorran)|Ivo]].
